summary.zh: 把叙事描述转成结构化的运镜提示词
summary.en: Turn narrative beats into structured camera prompts

description.zh: 把剧情或画面描述整理成包含机位、运镜、焦段等要素的提示词，用于 Runway Gen-3、Kling、Luma 等 AI 视频工具。适合需要稳定复现电影感镜头、或多次生成风格不统一时使用。
description.en: Compiles a scene description into a structured camera prompt covering angle, movement, lens and timing for Runway Gen-3, Kling and Luma. Use it when AI video outputs vary between takes or the camera work feels flat.
